name: physics_pile
purpose: kin/physics3d (P2b): 60 boxes and spheres dropped into a walled yard by Jolt at 60 Hz from a fixed recipe, 150 steps (2.5 s) in at frame 0. Drawn with the debug lines on: shapes as wireframes (green awake, blue asleep, grey static), the contact points (red crosses) and their normals (orange). No Cycles truth: the check is that two runs give the same picture byte for byte.
